title: Finite canonical Kummer character
statement: Let R be a strictly henselian DVR with fraction field K, separable closure E, and an algebraically closed field Ω containing E. Let n>0 be a unit in R. There is a continuous surjective homomorphism χ:Gal(E/K)→μ_n(Ω), with discrete target, such that for every irreducible π of R and every a in E with a^n=π, χ(h)=h(a)/a in Ω. This includes n=1; no compatible choice of roots is required.

source.place: Tags 0BUA and 0BUB; uniformizer radicals and tame kernel; compare ILO Expose XVII section 1.2, printed page 259.

proof.text: Simple-root Hensel lifting extracts an nth root of every unit. The strict-local root count exhausts all roots of unity in any extension; they come from R and are fixed by Gal(E/K).

The Eisenstein polynomial X^n-π is irreducible over R; the monic Gauss lemma makes it irreducible over K. Its root a exists in E since n is nonzero there. Normality realizes every conjugate ζa, proving surjectivity of h↦h(a)/a. Fixed roots of unity give multiplicativity.

The stabilizer of the algebraic element a is open in the Krull topology, proving continuity. A change of uniformizer multiplies a by an nth root of a unit and a root of unity; both are fixed. This gives the displayed formula simultaneously for every root and uniformizer.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BUA and 0BUB, with the direct Hensel-unit-root and telescoping specialization of more-algebra.tex Tag 09EE, written in the Lean helper docstrings.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_canonical_kummer_character
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing R]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (Ksep : Type w) [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep] [IsSepClosure K Ksep]
    (Ω : Type z) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra Ksep Ω]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hu : IsUnit (n : R)) :
    ∃ χ : Gal(Ksep/K) →* rootsOfUnity n Ω,
      @Continuous _ _ inferInstance ⊥ (fun h ↦ (χ h : Ωˣ)) ∧
      Function.Surjective χ ∧
      ∀ (π : R), Irreducible π → ∀ a : Ksep,
        a ^ n = algebraMap K Ksep (algebraMap R K π) →
        ∀ h : Gal(Ksep/K), (((χ h : Ωˣ) : Ω)) = algebraMap Ksep Ω (h a / a)
